color.$description: SEMANTIC color tokens — DARK mode (Lumen v0.12 default — Obsidian). Mirrors color.light.tokens.json key paths with the neutral obsidian ramp + spring-green accent. v0.12 retunes the brand canvas from v0.11 obsidian-mint #171A18 (with G+2 undertone) to neutral #0D0D0D — the dark side of the ramp is now true-neutral (R = G = B at every stop). Glass + glow utilities are exposed as separate semantic keys for clarity.

page.$description: Obsidian canvas #0D0D0D — user-fixed v0.12 brand dark (was #171A18 obsidian-mint pre-v0.12).

raised.$description: Raised surface #151515 — sits subtly above canvas via lightness alone (no chromatic tilt). v0.12 retune from #1B1E1C — the v0.11.11 'restrained mint tilt' is fully retired in v0.12; the canvas-to-raised lift is now ~2.2 percentage points of L on a neutral ramp.

popover.$description: Floating popover surface #1F1F1F — v0.12 (was #232624). Sits ~9.5% L vs canvas ~5.1% L on the neutral ramp.

glass.$description: Floating glass shell — pair with backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(140%). v0.11.13 — references the canvas-anchored alpha primitive. v0.12 — alpha ink anchor moved with the recolor (rgba(23,26,24,X) → rgba(13,13,13,X)); the alpha ladder + the surface contract are unchanged.

overlay.$description: Translucent backdrop for sticky chrome. v0.11.13 — references {color.alpha.ink.86}. v0.12 — ink anchor moved to neutral #0D0D0D.

scrim.$description: Modal scrim. v0.11.13 — references {color.alpha.void.72} (anchored to brand.950, which is #050505 in v0.12 / was #060807 pre-v0.12) so the scrim reads ~18% darker than canvas-anchored alpha and the floating modal is unmistakably above a darker plate.

tint-accent.$description: Spring-green tint for hover / selection backgrounds.

input.$description: v0.6 — input field surfaces. Aliased so theming can shift inputs without disturbing card chrome.

rest.$description: Same as surface.raised; named role for input bg.

readOnly.$description: Read-only keeps full contrast — same bg as rest. Caret hidden, content selectable.

disabled.$description: Sunken bg signals 'not interactive'. Paired with disabled border + text.

primary.$description: Body and titles — #E6E6E6, the user-fixed brand light value. Contrast ~15.5:1 on the v0.12 neutral obsidian canvas (#0D0D0D) — AAA. Was 13.7:1 on the v0.11 obsidian-mint canvas (#171A18). Not pure white (which would feel harsh on either canvas).

secondary.$description: Captions, descriptions. ~6.9:1 on the v0.12 canvas — AA Normal (was ~6.4:1 on the v0.11 obsidian-mint canvas).

tertiary.$description: Hints, eyebrow labels. ~3.65:1 on the v0.12 canvas — AA Large only (≥18px). Held at the same contrast tier as v0.11 (was 3.6:1).

placeholder.$description: Input placeholder. Alias of tertiary; carries its own role for theming.

accent.$description: Laser spring-green for inline emphasis on dark. ~10.4:1 — AAA.

error.$description: v0.11 — softened error text on canvas. ~7.0:1 on the v0.12 neutral canvas — AA Normal (was ~6.5:1 on v0.11 obsidian-mint). Distinct from status.danger.fg which is the badge text on a danger background. v0.11.13 — references the {color.status.danger.300} primitive (was inlined #F8A8AA).

success.$description: v0.6 — success text. Reuses accent ramp; spring green is action/live/success.

warning.$description: v0.11 — warning text. ~9.5:1 on the v0.12 neutral canvas — AAA (was ~9.1:1 on v0.11 obsidian-mint). v0.11.13 — references the {color.status.warning.300} primitive (was inlined #F5DEA3).

hairline.$description: Default hairline at 6% white — the breathing-room separator (per principles §1, §3).

frame.$description: v0.4 — brutalist hairline frame border, hairline-strong

error.$description: v0.6 — input error border. Refined red for the hairline stroke.

success.$description: v0.6 — input success border. Spring green; only after explicit validation.

warning.$description: v0.6 — input warning border. Refined amber.

disabled.$description: v0.6 — input disabled border. Muted; no hover/focus.

fg.$description: Near-black #07120D on spring green — 14.7:1 AAA. Never inherit text-primary. (Pre-v0.12 description called this 'near-black-mint' — the value is unchanged in v0.12, but the canvas underneath is now neutral so the 'mint' label was retired.)

tertiary.$description: v0.9 alias of ghost — kept for backwards compatibility. New code uses ghost surface composed with neutral intent. v0.11.13 — hover/press references {color.alpha.paper.06}.

ghost.$description: v0.9 — no chrome at rest, subtle hover tint. The neutral × ghost surface.

outline.$description: v0.9 — hairline pill (transparent fill, 1px border). The neutral × outline surface.

danger.$description: v0.11 — danger CTA on dark. bg deepened red.500→.700 to clear WCAG AA Normal.

fg.$description: 5.4:1 on danger.700 — passes AA Normal. v0.11.13 — references the new {color.absolute.white} primitive (was inlined #FFFFFF).

danger-soft.$description: v0.9 — danger × ghost surface. For destructive actions in tight contexts (table row delete, settings) where solid red would over-emphasize. v0.11.13 — bg.hover/press reference {color.alpha.danger.12}/{18}; fg references {color.status.danger.300}.

fg.$description: Lumen text.error — 6.5:1 on canvas. v0.11.13 — references the new status.danger.300 primitive.

ai.$description: v0.9 — AI-action variant. Spring-green tonal surface + sparkle leading icon. Sparingly: only on AI-driven primary actions (Improve, Summarize, Suggest, Quote-with-AI). Not a general-purpose intent. See ADR 0016.

fg.$description: Laser spring-green — brighter than accent.fg on tonal surface to maintain perceived hierarchy.

success.$description: v0.9 — success-affirmation feedback variant. Same spring-green palette as primary per the single-accent rule, but tonal not solid. Used briefly (1.6 s) post-success state of any button.

selected.$description: v0.9 — aria-pressed=true state for ToggleButton / Segmented option. Subtle spring-green tint + spring-green hairline. Distinct from primary (filled green).

glass.$description: v0.9 — translucent surface for floating overlays. Composes with backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Not a default primary. v0.11.13 — hover/press migrated from inline rgba(23,26,24,X) to {color.alpha.ink.72}/{86} so a future canvas retune cascades.

neutral.$description: v0.11.15 — neutral status pill bg + fg. Pre-v0.11.15 the bg ran through {color.brand.700} (raised), which collided with --surface-raised on Card-mounted badges and made the pill visually disappear. Re-anchored to a paper-alpha overlay so the chip reads as a slight lift on every dark surface (canvas, raised, popover, sunken).

bg.$description: Translucent overlay so the pill reads on any surface; the paper-alpha sits well against the v0.12 neutral obsidian canvas without competing with the spring-green accent (pre-v0.12 the canvas had a faint G tilt — paper-alpha works on both).

fg.$description: User-fixed brand light #E6E6E6 — 14.0:1 on the v0.12 raised surface (was 13.4:1 in v0.11). AAA.

aurora.$description: Radial spring-green ambient glow — the brand's signature lighting gesture. Render as a fixed/absolute pseudo-element behind the page hero with backdrop-filter: blur and the values below. v0.11 kept the v0.4 recipe verbatim — same opacity, new hue. v0.12 leaves the recipe untouched: the aurora's spring-green halo reads even more confidently against the neutral obsidian canvas (no green tilt in the canvas to compete with the halo's hue).

chart.$description: v0.13.2 — Lumen chart series palette. Six-position rotation aligned with charts.tsx CHART_PALETTE — Spring Green (current/active series, ONLY position 1), Cream (secondary), Amber (tertiary, warning-tier hue), Red (quaternary, 'negative/loss' series), Obsidian (quinary, rare), and the deeper Accent stop (senary, return to green family). See foundations/data-visualization.md §'Color rules' — exactly one series per chart paints in green per the brand contract. Color-blind-safe across deuteranopia / protanopia / tritanopia. Positions 7-8 reserved for future expansion; for now alias positions 7-8 to brand.300 and warning.700 respectively so consumers don't break when probing them.

1.$description: Spring Green — the current / active / primary series. Reserve for ONE series per chart only.

2.$description: Cream — secondary series. Warm-neutral, low-contrast against accent.

3.$description: Amber — tertiary series. Warning-tier hue, distinguishable from green.

4.$description: Red — quaternary series. Use for 'negative' / 'loss' series with semantic intent.

5.$description: Obsidian mid-grey — quinary series. Rarely needed.

6.$description: Deep Accent — senary series. Return to green family at darker stop.

7.$description: v0.13.2 — placeholder. Light obsidian. Probe-safe; reconfigure when a 7th series surfaces.

8.$description: v0.13.2 — placeholder. Dark amber. Probe-safe; reconfigure when an 8th series surfaces.

avatar.$description: v0.13.2 — Avatar fallback-background palette. Deterministic name-hashed selection; each user gets a stable color based on their name hash mod 8. All eight have ≥ 4.5:1 contrast against `color.text.on-avatar` (the on-avatar text token below) so initials always read.
